notes: Raised by the Flux rate limiter (src/rate_limits.py), which runs BEFORE forge_hook stamps the subscription tier. On /v1/chat/completions the forge failure hook (src/gateway.py:26070-26088) therefore sees tier='free' for EVERY key, finds 'exceeded' in str(exc) ('rate_limit_exceeded'), and rewrites the 429 into this 402 free_tier_exhausted. The original 429 body survives only on /v1/messages (message only) and /v1/responses (full dict, incl. error.state). No Retry-After / reset header on any endpoint. Live: caps {outcome: over_cap, tier: free} seeded in staging valkey for a non-internal key.
